profile.headline: Focused on the nexus of software engineering with measurement, analysis, and control of physical systems.
profile.summary:
Goal: build robust, maintainable, long-lived software on a foundation of solid tools, technologies, and design patterns in order to contribute to sustainable energy generation and utilization.

Expertise in C, C++11/14/17, STL, Boost, multi-threading, unit tests; OO Patterns; Windows, C#/.NET, VisualStudio, Eclipse; Linux, gcc/gdb, Winusb, libusb; Python, virtualenv, PyDev, PyUnit; SQL, JavaScript, websockets; Matlab/Octave; Git, Mercurial, Doxygen; Unicode, JSON, XML; TCP/IP, USB, RS-232, GPIO, I2C, SPI; BeagleBone, RaspberryPi, Arduino.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead software developer for Bond Aligner (BA) tool, comprising C++ and C# applications for machine control, camera and vision software interface (Cognex), liaison with robot supervisory software (Cluster), Aerotech motion stages, Omron PLCs, embedded PL/M 8051 controller, LEDs via WinUSB.  Responsible for BA software and hardware troubleshooting, often at customer sites.  Adapted BA software for several machine configurations. Collaboratively developed C++ application framework to Cluster supervisory interface. Adapted C++ “Spin Coater” tool software with Cluster supervisory interface. Integrated Cluster to Chiller via its RS-232 interface.

positions.title: Engineering Consulting
positions.description:
•	CHP free-piston Stirling engine project. Integrated grid-connected alternator analysis into “Laser” computer program; discovered and documented the causes of alternator instability and piston-centering behavior. (Microgen Energy Ltd, Peterborough UK)
•	Added SECS/GEM control protocol to specialized Prober. (IBM, Fishkill, NY)
•	Specialized Bond Aligner algorithm development. (Suss Microtec, Waterbury, VT)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead software development and maintenance for “Prober” tool. Lead development of a specialized Prober, with robotic wafer handling, for IBM Fishkill’s 300mm “fab”.  Developed foundation for a Linux-based embedded real-time controller for Prober tool.  Developed a Linux/Windows C++ framework encapsulating core legacy software architecture.  Developed key Windows applications for Prober tool with Borland C++Builder.

positions.title: Engineering Consulting
positions.description:
•	Embedded real-time control application for solar energy system (concentrator, heatpipe, and Stirling engine/alternator) in C++ (Cummins Power Generation, Abilene, TX)
•	PC-based data acquisition solutions for multiple engineering project (Cummins Power Generation; Sunpower Inc and Ohio University, Athens, OH; Thermacore Inc, Lancaster PA).
•	Developed Stirling engine analysis and design application “Laser” for Windows (using Borland C++/OWL, and RogueWave Tools, Math, and Linpack libraries).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Team member in design and implementation of C++ framework classes for a 4GL enterprise application development tool, built on POET object-oriented database.

positions.title: Programmer/Engineer
positions.description: Developed user interface for in-house Stirling cycle analysis application for Macintosh.  Developed data acquisition software for PC, including custom discrete Fourier transform algorithm.  Adapted data acquisition software for six hardware test projects.
